# OpenDyslexic

- Designer: Abbie Gonzalez.
- Home page: https://opendyslexic.org/
- Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`, unchanged from upstream), with Reserved Font Name "OpenDyslexic". Copyright (c) 2019-07-29, Abbie Gonzalez; copyright (c) 12/2012 - 2019. The repository's licence was checked on 2026-09-25: GitHub reports OFL-1.1 for the current `main` branch, and the release tag's `OFL.txt` is the one kept here.
- Version: the GitHub release `v0.91.12` (2019-10-17), the newest release; the fonts' `name` table says "Version 0.920".
- Source: the official GitHub release asset https://github.com/antijingoist/opendyslexic/releases/download/v0.91.12/opendyslexic-0.910.12-rc2-2019.10.17.zip (3,627,458 bytes, SHA-256 `b92d7fcb9409f2bcfd23b65ac71647256eb49c429f4fbb1cc870381fc93eb486`). The four `.otf` files below were extracted from it unchanged. The release archive has no licence file, so `OFL.txt` comes from the same tag: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antijingoist/opendyslexic/449a41bbc25f7363c540ad112dfcef2f7b340c0a/OFL.txt (tag `v0.91.12` is commit `449a41bbc25f7363c540ad112dfcef2f7b340c0a`).
- Downloaded: 2026-09-25.
- Embedding: OS/2 `fsType` 8 (editable embedding allowed). The outlines are CFF (OpenType `.otf`).
